readout_other: Left stellate ganglion (LSG) neural activity via microelectrode; ECG-based ventricular arrhythmia scoring and programmed electrophysiological stimulation; Western blot for IL-1b, TNF-a, IL-6; Iba-1 immunofluorescence (microglia); HE and TUNEL staining
direction_notes: LIFU stimulation of the PVN significantly decreased left stellate ganglion neural activity, reduced the inducibility of post-MI ventricular arrhythmias, and reduced microglial activation and myocardial inflammatory cytokine expression compared to MI without LIFU.
safety_notes: HE and TUNEL immunofluorescence staining showed no obvious extravasation of red blood cells, abnormal cell morphology, inflammatory response, or increased apoptosis in the brain tissue of chronically LIFU-stimulated rats.

device.manufacturer: Ultrasound Institute of Chongqing Medical University

timing.protocol_description: LIFU at an intensity of 2.0 W/cm2, a frequency of 1 MHz, a pulse repetition frequency of 1 kHz, a duration of 8 seconds, and a duty cycle of 50% was administered to the skull surface corresponding to the PVN for 10 minutes in the acute MI (AMI) + LIFU group and 15 minutes every day in the chronic MI (CMI) + LIFU group.

source_quotes.n_subjects: METHODS Fifty-four Sprague-Dawley rats were randomly divided into acute control (n 5 12, 22.22%), acute MI (AMI, n 5 12, 22.22%), AMI 1 LIFU (n 5 12, 22.22%), chronic control (n 5 6, 11.11%), chronic MI (CMI, n 5 6, 11.11%), and CMI 1 LIFU (n 5 6, 11.11%) groups. MI was induced by left anterior artery ligation, and electrocardiographic recording for 0.5 hours after MI and programmed electrophysiological stimulation were used to test the vulnerability of VAs. Peripheral sympathetic neural activity was assessed by measuring left stellate ganglion neural activity. Finally, hearts and brains were extracted for Western blotting and histopathological analysis, respectively.

flags.reason: Paper gives group sizes for acute (n=12) and chronic (n=6) LIFU-treated groups but no single stated total exposed to ultrasound; reported as a list
Acute group received a single 10-minute LIFU session while chronic group received daily 15-minute sessions for 4 weeks (~28 sessions); no single value applies to both

Paper reports a single 'intensity' value of 2.0 W/cm2 without specifying whether it is spatial-peak pulse-average (ISPPA) or spatial-peak temporal-average (ISPTA), and without stating measurement domain (free field vs in situ)
Pulse duration was not stated directly; computed from stated duty cycle (50%) and PRF (1 kHz) per the burst-duration rule
